correctness.rationale: Nondegenerate trace pairing and character orthogonality in Y give q^(n²) times the affine fiber {X:ad_C X=-B}. The trace adjoint of ad_C is -ad_C, so a second character sum is nonzero precisely for A,B both in im ad_C and has modulus q^(n²+c(C)). Primary decomposition by invariant factors gives centralizer dimension sum_r r sum(lambda_i'²) and automorphism unit counts, hence the rational-canonical Euler product multiplicities. Scalar C yields c=n² and cyclic C yields c=n, proving sharp positive condition number q^(n²-n). All nonscalar noncyclic 3x3 matrices are rank-one nilpotent perturbations of scalars or split (2,1)-eigenspace type; independent enumeration of all 512 M3(F2) verifies centralizer counts c=3:412,c=5:98,c=9:2 and convolution rank 1712642. All q,n conclusions come from algebraic proof, not this finite check.
